sources.role: official Windows archive containing Apf_emuw.exe and manuals
APFEMU-Eng.txt documents configuration, keyboard overrides, media and controls

paths.naming: The official APFEMU-Eng.txt says the program stores configuration in apf_emuw.ini in the Windows directory; no schema or portable relocation is documented.

Plain text lines with two numbers: the Windows key value followed by the corresponding APF key value. The bundled TECLADO file illustrates the default keyboard/joystick layout. Physical joystick identity and the Windows key layout are runtime-owned.
evidence: docs:APFEMU-Eng.txt keyboard and joystick mapping/KYS format @adb6c061

paths.path: User-selected APF media files (cassette .APT and disk/cartridge media); no universal emulator save sidecar is documented.
paths.naming: APF BASIC software uses its own CSAVE/CLOAD and SAVE/RUN disk commands; media filenames are selected by the emulator UI.

paths.path: No emulator save-state file or slot mechanism is documented.
paths.naming: APF media/program SAVE commands are guest data, not emulator states.

paths.path: No external BIOS filename or checksum is documented; APF machine behavior is supplied by the standalone executable and selected media.
paths.naming: No separate firmware asset is identified in the official archive documentation.

paths.path: No cryptographic key file is documented.

linux.reason: The official artifact is a Windows executable and its configuration uses the Windows directory; no Linux native build is provided.
